data.name: Emaad
data.gender_notes: Emaad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Emaad (عماد) means 'support', 'pillar', or 'firmness'. It signifies stability and strength. The name Emaad carries the meaning “Firmness, stability” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Emaad usually hope their child will grow to embody firmness, stability and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, 'emad' refers to a pillar or support, symbolizing one's faith as a stronghold.
data.etymology: Emaad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Firmness, stability.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emaad total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عماد
in_arabic.meaning: عماد تعالی کا ستون, دین کا معاون
in_arabic.long_meaning: عماد (Emaad) کا نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'تعالی کا ستون' یا 'دین کا معاون'۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر نہیں ہوا، لیکن اس کے معنی اسلامی اقدار کے ساتھ میل کھاتے ہیں۔ عماد بن خطاب، ایک صحابی رسول اللہ، نے بھی اس نام کو شان بخشا ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام فرد کی اہمیت اور ذمہ داری کا اظہار کرتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: عماد
in_urdu.meaning: عماد تعالی کا ستون, دین کا مضبوط حامی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عماد (Emaad) کا نام عربی جڑوں سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'اللہ تعالی کا ستون' یا 'دین کا مضبوط حامی'۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، یہ نام روحانی مضبوطی اور حمایت کی علامت ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر، عماد ایک ایسے شخص کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے جو اسلامی اقدار کو برقرار رکھنے میں اہم کردار ادا کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इमाद
in_hindi.meaning: इमाद परमेश्वर का स्तंभ, धर्म का सहायक
in_hindi.long_meaning: इमाद (Emaad) नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है 'परमेश्वर का स्तंभ' या 'धर्म का सहायक'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक समर्थन और धार्मिक समर्पण का प्रतीक है। यह नाम व्यक्ति की जिम्मेदारी और चरित्र की मजबूती को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: عماد
in_pashto.meaning: عماد د الله تعالی ستون، دین مرستیال
in_pashto.long_meaning: عماد (Emaad) نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې 'د الله تعالی ستون' یا 'دین مرستیال' دی. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا نوم د روحانيت او ديني ارزښتونو د ساتنې نښه ده. دا نوم د يو فرد د پياوړتيا او د اسلامي ارزښتونو د ملاتړو څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Emaad
in_english.meaning: Pillar of God, supporter of the faith
in_english.long_meaning: The name Emaad originates from Arabic roots 'imad' (عماد), meaning 'pillar' or 'supporter'. In Islamic tradition, Emaad signifies a strong supporter of faith and a pillar of spiritual strength. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the name aligns with Islamic values of responsibility and steadfastness. Historically, companions of Prophet Muhammad like Ammar ibn Yasir reflected similar virtues. The name Emaad represents an individual of great character and commitment to their beliefs.

It symbolizes strong foundations, unwavering support, and unshakeable pillars, qualities that are highly valued in society. Emaad can be seen as a source of strength, standing firm against adversities. It can also symbolize the idea of being a supportive partner, family member, or friend.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Emaad carries deeper meaning. It reflects the strong belief in Allah as the ultimate source of support and strength for believers. The name Emaad serves as a reminder of Allah's steadfastness and unwavering commitment to His creation. Additionally, it can signify the individual's strive towards being a solid, unwavering supporter of their faith, community, and values. Overall, Emaad represents a fusion of stability, strength, and spiritual resilience.
